name: Octagonal Mirror
description: The ancient dressing culture originated in 2000 BC. People used fire to smelt bronze, carefully polished it, and made it into bronze mirrors, which reflected every girl's heartfelt moment of pursuing beauty. Spanning the long river of history, Pinku imitates gilding, dotted green, and filigree inlay techniques, and incorporates elements of the beautiful "magpie" to create "Linghua Mirror·Magpie Shadow" and continue to write the oriental romantic dressing epic.
